integrity: The proof is analytic. The defining H_p formula and its parameter reduction were checked in the Baronti–Bertella full text, and the classification of isosceles-orthogonal pairs in symmetric planes was checked in the Balestro–Martini–Teixeira full text. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The structural identity assumes a symmetric Minkowski plane. The closed secant formula is proved for affine regular 4n-gonal unit circles and does not classify arbitrary centrally symmetric polygonal norms. Bibliographic search cannot establish absolute novelty.
title: Quadratic isosceles constant as rotation distortion in symmetric planes
